name: document-kit
description: Shared document framework: one block model, Word output, client-side layout to PDF and page pictures, and Word template filling. Runs entirely in the browser.

scripts.build: vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p src/template/tsconfig.build.json
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p src/template/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.integration.json --noEmit
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run test:browser
